## Behavior changed

Describe the problem and observable result.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit/regression tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Security cases cover changes to URLs, DNS, proxies, credentials and limits (or explain why not applicable).
- [ ] Docker/browser checks pass when integration changed; attach results or state the blocker.
- [ ] Dependency audit passes; no keys or scraped personal data in artifacts.
- [ ] If an LLM/agent changed: evaluate accuracy, schema/grounding, prompt injection, tool authorization, data leakage, cost and termination using docs/CI.md.

Record commands/results and any remaining limitations.
